steps.text:
分析 将级数的通项进行适当的放大，得到能求出其和为 p 的级数即可.

$$
u _ {n} = \frac {1}{(n + 1) \sqrt [ p ]{n}} = n ^ {1 - \frac {1}{p}} \frac {1}{n (n + 1)} = n ^ {(p - 1) / p} \left(\frac {1}{n} - \frac {1}{n + 1}\right) = n ^ {(p - 1) / p} \left(\left(\frac {1}{\sqrt [ p ]{n}}\right) ^ {p} - \left(\frac {1}{\sqrt [ p ]{n + 1}}\right) ^ {p}\right).
$$

由拉格朗日中值定理 $b^{p} - a^{p} = p\xi^{p - 1}(b - a)$ （ $\xi$ 在 $a$ 与 $b$ 之间），有

$$
\begin{array}{l} u _ {n} = n ^ {(p - 1) / p} p \xi^ {p - 1} \left(\frac {1}{\sqrt [ p ]{n}} - \frac {1}{\sqrt [ p ]{n + 1}}\right) \quad \left(\xi \in \left(\frac {1}{\sqrt [ p ]{n + 1}}, \frac {1}{\sqrt [ p ]{n}}\right)\right) \\ = n ^ {(p - 1) / p} p \left(\frac {1}{\sqrt [ p ]{n + \theta}}\right) ^ {p - 1} \left(\frac {1}{\sqrt [ p ]{n}} - \frac {1}{\sqrt [ p ]{n + 1}}\right) (0 <   \theta <   1) \\ = \left(\frac {n}{n + \theta}\right) ^ {(p - 1) / p} p \left(\frac {1}{\sqrt [ p ]{n}} - \frac {1}{\sqrt [ p ]{n + 1}}\right) <   p \left(\frac {1}{\sqrt [ p ]{n}} - \frac {1}{\sqrt [ p ]{n + 1}}\right), \end{array}
$$

故

$$
\sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \frac {1}{(n + 1) \sqrt [ p ]{n}} <   p \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \left(\frac {1}{\sqrt [ p ]{n}} - \frac {1}{\sqrt [ p ]{n + 1}}\right) = p \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \left(1 - \frac {1}{\sqrt [ p ]{n + 1}}\right) = p.
$$
分析 将级数的通项进行适当的放大，得到能求出其和为 p 的级数即可.

$$
u _ {n} = \frac {1}{(n + 1) \sqrt [ p ]{n}} = n ^ {1 - \frac {1}{p}} \frac {1}{n (n + 1)} = n ^ {(p - 1) / p} \left(\frac {1}{n} - \frac {1}{n + 1}\right) = n ^ {(p - 1) / p} \left(\left(\frac {1}{\sqrt [ p ]{n}}\right) ^ {p} - \left(\frac {1}{\sqrt [ p ]{n + 1}}\right) ^ {p}\right).
$$
由拉格朗日中值定理 $b^{p} - a^{p} = p\xi^{p - 1}(b - a)$ （ $\xi$ 在 $a$ 与 $b$ 之间），有

$$
\sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \frac {1}{(n + 1) \sqrt [ p ]{n}} <   p \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \left(\frac {1}{\sqrt [ p ]{n}} - \frac {1}{\sqrt [ p ]{n + 1}}\right) = p \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \left(1 - \frac {1}{\sqrt [ p ]{n + 1}}\right) = p.
$$
